test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The radius and the height of a cylinder are in the ratio 3 : 4 respectively. If the volume of the cylinder is ____________ cm³, then the curved surface area of the cylinder is __________ cm² less than the total surface area of the cylinder. (Take π = 3)

The values given in which of the following options will fill the blanks in the same order in which is it given to make the above statement true:

A. 2916,486

B. 864,192

C. 6912,864

D. 13500,1250
solution:
**Given:**

r : h = 3 : 4

π = 3

**Formula Used:**

Volume = πr²h = 108k³

Difference (TSA − CSA) = 2πr² = 54k²

**Calculation:**

⇒ Option A: 108k³ = 2916 ⇒ k³ = 27 ⇒ k = 3

⇒ Difference = 54k² = 54 × 9 = 486 Correct

⇒ Option B: 108k³ = 864 ⇒ k³ = 8 ⇒ k = 2

⇒ Difference = 54k² = 54 × 4 = 216 ≠ 192, Wrong

⇒ Option C: 108k³ = 6912 ⇒ k³ = 64 ⇒ k = 4

⇒ Difference = 54k² = 54 × 16 = 864 Correct

⇒ Option D: 108k³ = 13500 ⇒ k³ = 125 ⇒ k = 5

⇒ Difference = 54k² = 54 × 25 = 1350 ≠ 1250, Wrong

**∴ The correct answers are** **Only A and C.**
